title: EQLI / Entangletronica: Electrostatic Quantum-Lens Interferometry in InGaAs 2DEGs (v5.0.0)
description:
Reproducible split-step Schrodinger simulations of a single flying electron through a gate-defined double-slit interferometer in a ballistic 2DEG (InGaAs), with a programmable electrostatic phase lens, a Poisson-Thomas-Fermi voltage mapping, a conservative white-noise dephasing budget, a 200-realisation stochastic-dephasing ensemble, and correlated-noise checks.

IMPORTANT VERSION NOTE: v5.0.0 corrects misleading temperature claims of earlier versions and adds an electrostatic-selectivity analysis (differential-selectivity ratio ~0.69; amplitude 50 meV/V and dephasing scale s_phi=22 are empirical calibration parameters, not first-principles predictions; SET readout at T < 1 K is the practical thermal bottleneck, not the ~11 K interferometer-coherence bound). v1 and earlier versions should not be cited: they overstate the temperature compatibility of the proposed logic primitives. The current record is the version of record.
